cands.name: Michael Ferguson
cands.bio: Democratic nominee for open HD 100. Lawyer at Krupnick Campbell Malone; former Air Force captain, prosecutor, defense lawyer and special trial counsel. Former Cardinal Gibbons High running back and football captain.
cands.local_ties: Grew up in the district and lives in Lauderdale-by-the-Sea (Florida Politics).

record.text: Has not held elected office. Entered the race in April 2026 with no primary opponent; says he has knocked on more than 40,000 doors.

money_notes.text: Campaign spent about $116,000 and announced a six-figure ad buy; Engaged Communities, the committee associated with him, spent another $102,000 since April.

cands.name: Yoni Anijar
cands.bio: Republican nominee for open HD 100. Corporate lawyer and U.S. Army Reserve JAG captain, 35; first-generation American born to Israeli immigrants. Won a four-way primary with 37.6%.
cands.local_ties: Broward County filer; Florida Politics gives no specific hometown.

record.text: Has not held elected office; interned in the Florida House and Congress 2011-2014; former vice president of Broward Young Republicans. Told the Sun-Sentinel he believes the 2020 election was 'rigged'. Was a Democrat until 2022, briefly registered Independent Party, then Republican.

money_notes.text: Put $235,000 of his own money into the race on top of about $282,000 raised through late July; his campaign and political committee had spent about $367,000 through Oct. 27.

endorsements.text: RNC Chair and Sen. Joe Gruters; Rep. Meg Weinberger; Broward Young Republicans (primary-stage endorsements).
